user:
Handbook: Official MTO Driver's Handbook (Ontario, Canada)
Units: metric (m, km, km/h)
Topic: passing
Batch: 7 passages from the page "Stopping": c1, c2, c3, c4, m77, c5, m16.

[c1] page: Stopping | heading: Stopping for school buses · ¶2 | text
You must stop whenever you approach a stopped school bus with its upper alternating red lights flashing, regardless of whether you are behind the bus or approaching it from the front.

[c2] page: Stopping | heading: Stopping for school buses · ¶2 | text
If you are coming from behind the bus, stop at least 20 metres away.

[c3] page: Stopping | heading: Stopping for school buses · ¶2 | text
Do not go until the bus moves or the lights have stopped flashing.

[c4] page: Stopping | heading: Stopping for school buses · ¶3 | text
If you are on a road with a median strip, only vehicles coming from behind the bus must stop.

[m77] page: Stopping | heading: Stopping for school buses · ¶6 | text
In Ontario, school bus drivers and other witnesses can report vehicles that have illegally passed a school bus.

[c5] page: Stopping | heading: Stopping for school buses · ¶6 | text
If you don't stop, you can be fined heavily and get six demerit points for a first offence.

[m16] page: Stopping | heading: Stopping for pedestrian crossovers · ¶2 | text
You must not pass any vehicle within 30 metres of a pedestrian crossover.

Write the reading notes for all 7 passages, then the statements, following sections 4 and 5. Return only the JSON object.

passages.says: rule: must stop when approaching a stopped school bus with flashing red lights, whether behind or from the front
rule: if coming from behind the bus, stop at least 20 m away
rule: do not go (pass) until the bus moves or lights stop flashing
exception: on a road with a median strip, only vehicles coming from behind must stop (vehicles from the front are exempt)
fact: school bus drivers and witnesses can report vehicles that illegally passed a school bus
penalty: heavy fine and 6 demerit points for a first offence of not stopping
rule: must not pass any vehicle within 30 m of a pedestrian crossover

statements.text: a driver MUST stop WHEN approaching a stopped school bus with its upper alternating red lights flashing AND the driver is behind the bus OR the driver is approaching the bus from the front UNLESS the road has a median strip AND the driver is approaching the bus from the front UNTIL the bus moves OR the lights have stopped flashing IF VIOLATED a heavy fine AND 6 demerit points for a first offence

sources.quote: You must stop whenever you approach a stopped school bus with its upper alternating red lights flashing, regardless of whether you are behind the bus or approaching it from the front.
If you are on a road with a median strip, only vehicles coming from behind the bus must stop.
Do not go until the bus moves or the lights have stopped flashing.
If you don't stop, you can be fined heavily and get six demerit points for a first offence.

statements.note: The exception for median strips is written as an UNLESS clause because it is in the same section. The penalty is attached to the failure to stop.

statements.force_from: context (section "Stopping for school buses" and c1 "must stop")
statements.text: a driver MUST stop at least 20 m from the school bus WHEN approaching a stopped school bus with its upper alternating red lights flashing AND the driver is behind the bus

sources.quote: If you are coming from behind the bus, stop at least 20 metres away.
You must stop whenever you approach a stopped school bus with its upper alternating red lights flashing, regardless of whether you are behind the bus or approaching it from the front.

flags.note: The sentence is an imperative without explicit legal wording, but it specifies a precise distance for a legal duty (stopping for a bus), so it is treated as part of the legal requirement.

statements.note: The condition 'approaching a stopped school bus with flashing lights' is added from c1 to make the statement self-contained.

statements.text: FACT school bus drivers and other witnesses can report vehicles that have illegally passed a school bus IN Ontario

sources.quote: In Ontario, school bus drivers and other witnesses can report vehicles that have illegally passed a school bus.

statements.text: a driver MUST NOT pass any vehicle WHEN the driver is within 30 m of a pedestrian crossover

sources.quote: You must not pass any vehicle within 30 metres of a pedestrian crossover.
